audit_scope.description: Trust model for EIP-7762 (blob gas minimum fee increase), EIP-152 (BLAKE2 precompile), EIP-7329 (EIP/ERC repository split), EIP-2378 (EIP eligibility lifecycle), and EIP-3709 (Type 1 to Type 2 transaction conversion).
in_scope: Blob gas minimum base fee validation in block headers (EIP-7762)
BLAKE2b F compression precompile input validation and execution (EIP-152)
Wallet-level Type 1 to Type 2 transaction conversion (EIP-3709)
out_of_scope: EIP-7329 EIP/ERC repository split (governance process, no runtime protocol impact)
EIP-2378 EIP eligibility lifecycle (governance process, no runtime protocol impact)

misclassified_entities.reason: Proposal authors are governance participants in the EIP/ERC process, not protocol-level external entities. EIP-7329 is a governance process EIP.
misclassified_entities.correct_classification: Governance entity (out of scope for protocol trust model)

misclassified_entities.correct_classification: Governance entity (out of scope for protocol trust model)

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Producer
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P block propagation / Engine API newPayload
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Block producers set blob gas parameters in headers; blocks received over P2P are untrusted and must be validated against the updated minimum base fee formula.

trusted_external_entities.name: Precompile Caller
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: EVM CALL to BLAKE2 precompile address (0x09)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Any contract can invoke the BLAKE2 precompile with arbitrary 213-byte input; input validation must reject malformed data.

trusted_external_entities.name: User or DApp
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Users or DApps submitting Type 1 transactions to wallets are external; the wallet must correctly convert to Type 2 format.

boundary_edges.data_crossing_boundary: Block headers with blob_base_fee field subject to updated minimum
213-byte input: rounds (4 bytes) + h (64 bytes) + m (128 bytes) + t (16 bytes) + f (1 byte)
boundary_edges.trust_boundary: EVM execution boundary - any contract can call

boundary_edges.data_crossing_boundary: Type 1 (EIP-2930) transaction with access_list and gas_price for conversion

gaps: EIP-7329 and EIP-2378 are governance-only EIPs with no protocol runtime impact; their external entities are governance participants.
EIP-3709 operates at the wallet layer, not directly at the EL client; the trust boundary is between DApp and wallet.
